camera.shot_scale_bias: handheld medium shots inside handmade sets

lens.dof: moderate focus that keeps the handmade construction visible

sources: visible work lamps in the set
lighting.practicals: lighting is plain and does not hide how anything was built

rules: sets visibly made from cardboard, felt, tape and paint
in-camera effects with seams left showing
composition.movement_of_subject: objects transform in-shot by simple practical means rather than by edit

sound.ambience_bias: close handled-material sounds, paper, tape, fabric, small motors

music.instrumentation: A toy piano and brushed drums with a simple bass line

must_include: the set is visibly handmade from cardboard, felt and paper with the seams showing
transformations happen physically in shot rather than by cutting

notes: Handmade in-camera invention. The construction is meant to be visible; the charm is that nothing hides how it was done.
